built: by tools/data-map-build.mjs from data-map/*.json; edit those, not this

enewsIssues.what: An e-news or one-off email: a draft, scheduled, sending or sent.
enewsIssues.selfWhy: Only a draft can be deleted (the rules); a sent issue is the record of what went out.

links.why: The issue holds its own copy of the blocks; the template was only where it started.

enewsIssues/*/sends.what: One person an issue was sent to, written as it goes.

links.why: A list of who was sent a deleted draft means nothing alone.
It records a send that happened, whoever has since left the list.

enewsPreview.what: The 'view in your browser' copy of an issue before it is sent, at an unguessable link.

links.why: A preview of a deleted draft must stop being readable by its link.

enewsWeb.what: The public web copy of a sent issue, without the members-only blocks.
enewsWeb.archiveField: Never deleted: it is the e-news archive anyone can read.

links.why: Sent issues can't be deleted; if one ever were, its public copy is still what went out.

enewsSubscribers.what: A subscriber's address and the history of how they agreed.
enewsSubscribers.selfWhy: Unsubscribing keeps the record of consent; erasing a person goes through the privacy tools.

links.why: A subscriber's agreement stands on their own email address, not on the address book.

emailDrafts.what: The email compiler's drafts: wording only, the addresses are chosen when it is sent.

enewsSettings.what: The e-news look, footer and welcome email switches.

welcomeSent.what: Who has had a welcome email.

links.why: It still stops a second welcome if the same person signs up again.

hqMailEvents.what: Receipts from the email service: delivered, bounced, complained.

integrationSecrets.what: Canva's sign-in tokens; the server's alone.

unsplashCache.what: Picture searches kept for a day.

socialPosts.what: A day's countdown or post, until it is posted.

links.why: A countdown to an event that no longer exists must not be posted; one already posted stays, with the event's title copied in.

socialSettings.what: The card maker's hashtags, verse of the day and reminders.

links.why: Teams are archived, not deleted; a notice keeps who it was for.

churchMeetings.what: A members' meeting: date, place, papers (files under churchMeetings/<id>/papers/).
churchMeetings.archiveField: status; the rules refuse a delete, because a meeting and its votes are part of the church's record.

churchMeetings/*/private.what: A meeting's Zoom link and passcode, for members only.

links.why: The joining details mean nothing without the meeting.

churchMeetings/*/proxies.what: Who holds whose vote at a meeting.

links.why: A proxy is for one meeting.
Part of the record of how the meeting's votes were held.

churchMeetings/*/votes.what: A question put to a meeting.
churchMeetings/*/votes.selfWhy: Only while a draft (the rules); once open it is part of the record.

links.why: A vote is for one meeting; its ballots and count go with it.

churchMeetings/*/votes/*/ballots.what: Who voted, and how on an open vote.

links.why: A ballot is for one vote (and a vote is only deleted while a draft, before anyone can vote).
Part of the meeting's record.
The count is for one vote.

meetingPaperLinks.what: A member's own link to a meeting's papers, kept as its hash.

links.why: A link to a meeting that is gone must stop working.
A personal link for someone no longer in the address book must stop working.

sermons.what: A sermon: uploaded, or read from the podcast feed.
sermons.archiveField: published; the rules refuse a delete, and the podcast's episode ids must never be reused.

links.why: Series are never deleted (the rules refuse it).

sermonSeries.what: A sermon series, with its artwork.
sermonSeries.archiveField: The rules refuse a delete; sermons point at it.

sermonShow.what: The podcast feed's address, what its last read found, and who looks after sermons.

listenProgress/*/sermons.what: A listener's place in a sermon.
listenProgress/*/sermons.archiveField: Never deleted from a page; the listener's own.

links.why: People are archived; erasure goes through the privacy tools.
Sermons are never deleted.

videos.what: The channel's videos (hidden, not deleted) and members-only service videos.

watchShow.what: The church's channel, and this week's live link.

giftAid.selfWhy: HMRC may ask to see it: cancelled, never deleted, kept as retention.html says.

links.why: It holds the giver's own name and address, which is what HMRC needs.

regularGifts.what: A regular gift by Direct Debit.
regularGifts.selfWhy: Money: a gift is ended, never deleted.

links.why: The gift holds the giver's own name.

donations.selfWhy: The finance record, and Gift Aid is claimed from it.

links.why: Regular gifts are never deleted; the donation copies the giver's name anyway.
The finance record stands on its own.

helpAiUse.what: How many help questions were asked today, for the daily caps.

helpAiLog.what: Each help question: the page, its length and the outcome, never the words.

helpAiState.what: Whether the help AI's key last worked.

calEvents.what: An event on What's on: title, time, place, who it is for, sign-up settings.

links.why: Sites are taken out of use, never deleted.
Rooms are taken out of use, never deleted.
The other events of a series stand alone when one goes.

calEvents/*/ticketTypes.what: A ticket type on an event's sign-up form (name, price, places).

links.why: Part of the event's form; means nothing alone. Sign-ups copy the ticket's name and price.

calEvents/*/questions.what: A question on an event's sign-up form.

links.why: Part of the event's form; the answers are kept on each sign-up.

capacity.what: How many places an event has taken (a counter).

links.why: A count for one event; nothing to count once it has gone.

signups.what: One person's sign-up to an event, with their answers.

links.why: Who came, and what they paid for, is kept; the page already says sign-ups are not deleted.
People are archived; erasure goes through the privacy tools.

signupPayments.what: The payment for a sign-up (amount, method, paid or not).

links.why: A finance record stays whatever happens to the sign-up.
An event that has taken money is cancelled, not deleted, so the accounts still add up.

seriesSignups.what: A sign-up to several events of a series at once.

links.why: The sign-up stands for the events still there.
As above.

eventInvites.what: An invitation to an event, with its reply link.

links.why: An invitation to something that isn't happening means nothing.
People are archived.

eventChecklists.what: The organiser's to-do list for one event.

links.why: The event's own working list.

checklistTemplates.what: A starting to-do list the office keeps.

checklistReminders.what: A note that a checklist reminder was sent.

links.why: Only stops a reminder going twice (its id starts with the event id).

eventNotes.what: The team's private notes on one event.

links.why: Working notes for the event only.

eventChanges.what: A log line: what was changed on an event, and by whom.

links.why: The log is how the office sees what happened.

commsLog.what: A log line: an email sent about an event.

links.why: A record of what people were told.

downloadsLog.what: A log line: who downloaded an event's list.

links.why: Data protection: who took personal data off the hub.

calEventsDeleted.what: A line for each deleted event (title, when, who deleted it).

eventCategories.what: A kind of event (for filtering What's on).

links.why: People are archived.

importKeys.what: A ChurchSuite item already imported, so the import never makes it twice.

signupUsual.what: A person's usual sign-up answers, to fill the form next time.

headcounts.what: A head count taken at an event.

links.why: Attendance figures are kept for the church's records.

checkins.what: One person or child checked in to an event or a Kids Church morning.

links.why: Past check-ins are a safeguarding and fire record.
Children are archived, never deleted.
Families are archived.

checkinSettings.what: How check-in works for one event.

links.why: Settings for that event only.

uploadLinks.what: A link people use to send the office files for an event.

links.why: Nothing to upload to once the event has gone.

uploadItems.what: One file sent through an upload link.

links.why: Belongs to the link; the link going means the files are no longer wanted.

forms.what: A form the office makes (consent, medical, booking forms).

links.why: Sites are taken out of use.

eventForms.what: Which forms an event asks for.

links.why: Settings for that event only.

formRequests.what: A request for someone to fill a form.

links.why: A request for a form that no longer exists can't be answered.
Asked only for that event.
A form with answers is kept until the answers reach their retention date, so the answers still make sense.
Consent and medical answers follow their own retention period.

sensitiveResponses.what: The private part of a form's answers (medical, consent).

links.why: The private half of one set of answers; retention.html deletes both together.

eventLeaders.what: Who leads an event, by member.

links.why: Settings for that event only; the safeguarding record keeps its own copy of who led.

eventExceptions.what: Someone allowed into one event's records as an exception.

links.why: Access to something that no longer exists.

leaderChecks.what: A leader's DBS and training checks.

links.why: People are archived.

sgActivities.what: A kind of activity safeguarding plans for.

sgRisks.what: A safeguarding risk and what is done about it.

links.why: A safeguarding record never loses its event: cancel the event instead.
Activities are archived.

sgNoted.what: Leaders' note that they have read an event's safeguarding plan.

links.why: A safeguarding record: cancel the event instead.

sgPolicyReads.what: Who has read the policy for an event.

links.why: A safeguarding record: cancel the event instead.

sgAssessments.what: An event's safeguarding assessment and sign-off.

links.why: A safeguarding record: cancel the event instead.

sgGate.what: Whether an event's sign-ups wait for safeguarding sign-off.

links.why: A switch for that event only.

sgWarnings.what: A site's safeguarding warnings, worked out by the server.

links.why: Sites are taken out of use.

sgDashboard.what: A site's safeguarding summary, worked out by the server.

links.why: Sites are taken out of use.

sgReviews.what: A safeguarding review of a record.

sgAiLog.what: A line for each safeguarding AI draft.

sgSnapshots.what: A copy of a safeguarding record at sign-off.

links.why: An accident record never loses its event: cancel the event instead.
A safeguarding record never loses its event: cancel the event instead.

safeguardingSettings.what: The church's safeguarding leads and settings.

retentionLog.what: A line for each record retention removed.

sites.what: A building or place the church uses.

links.why: A building can't be taken out of use while its rooms are in use: take the rooms out first.

roomProfiles.what: A room's health and safety details.

links.why: Rooms are taken out of use.

roomDays.what: One room's day as 96 quarter-hours, taken or free.

links.why: Rooms are taken out of use; past days are history.

roomClosures.what: A room closed for a time (repairs, an event).

links.why: Sites are taken out of use.

roomClosedDays.what: One day of a room closure, for the booking rules.

links.why: A day of a closure that no longer exists.
Rooms are taken out of use.

bookings.what: A room booking (a member's, a hire, or an event's).

links.why: A room with bookings still to come can't be taken out of use: move or cancel them first.
An event's booking still to come is cancelled and the room given back; past ones stay as history.
Hirers are kept for the accounts.

cateringOrders.what: The kitchen's list for one booking.

links.why: The kitchen's copy of the booking (cateringSync already removes it).

bookingTypes.what: A kind of booking and its rules.

bookableResources.what: Kit a booking can reserve (projector, urn).

venues.what: A place outside the church's buildings.

terms.what: Hire terms and conditions, by version.

charges.what: A charge for a hire or a booking.

links.why: A finance record stays whatever happens to the booking.

accountsQueue.what: An item waiting for the treasurer.

raHire.what: The risk assessment for one hire.

links.why: A health and safety record stays.

kidsFamilies.what: A family registered for Kids Church.

kidsChildren.what: A child registered for Kids Church.

Groups are archived.

kidsMedical.what: A child's medical and allergy notes.

links.why: Only ever about that child; erasure of the child removes it.

kidsMornings.what: One Kids Church morning (who leads, which room).

kidsRoll.what: A child on one morning's register.

links.why: Attendance is a safeguarding record; children are archived.

kidsLeaderIns.what: A leader signed in on a morning.

kidsTerms.what: A site's Kids Church term dates.

kidsCounts.what: Numbers per morning, worked out by the server.

kidsScreenNos.what: Numbers shown on the screen to call parents.

screenPages.what: A page for the Kids Church screen.

links.why: Part of the group.
Membership of a group that no longer exists.
The group's own diary.

smallGroupAttendance.what: Who came to a group meeting.

links.why: Attendance is kept for pastoral follow-up.
The group's own messages.

smallGroupRequests.what: A request to join a group.

links.why: A request to join something that has gone.

smallGroupExceptions.what: Someone allowed into a group's records as an exception.

links.why: Access to something that has gone.

raSiteRoles.what: A site's health and safety and fire leads.

links.why: Sites are taken out of use.
A health and safety record never loses its event: cancel the event instead.

raEvents.what: Which risk assessments an event uses.

links.why: A health and safety record: cancel the event instead.

raReads.what: Who has read a risk assessment.

raStatus.what: Where a risk assessment has got to.

raReports.what: A report read into a risk assessment.

hazards.what: A hazard reported in a building.

riskSnapshots.what: A copy of the risks at a date.

loneContacts.what: Who to call for lone working.

links.why: Only means something for a current driver (the page removes both together).

presentDecks.what: A set of slides in Present.

links.why: Part of the deck.

presentAllow.what: Someone allowed to present in a meeting.

planGroups.what: A group with a teaching plan (Kids Church, youth).

planSessions.what: One session's plan, shown by ChurchShow.

links.why: The page promises a group's plans stay when the group is removed.

sermonLinks.what: A sermon's link to a plan, kept by the server.

addressBook.what: A person in the church's address book.

links.why: People are archived, never deleted; erasure goes through the privacy tools.

users.what: A sign-in account: its person, teams, admin areas and status.

links.why: People are archived, never deleted.
Teams are archived, never deleted.
Teams are archived, never deleted.

Teams are archived, never deleted.
